name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.7 degrees south of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 15 times in 10 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2025-06-06, at wavelengths from 1.00 to 4.93 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
